definitions.explanation: Sesame seeds, widely used in Japanese cuisine as a topping, flavoring, or ingredient in sauces and dressings.

examples.japanese: {胡麻|ごま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白|しろ}{胡麻|ごま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふった。
examples.english: I sprinkled white sesame seeds on the salad.

examples.japanese: すり{鉢|ばち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{胡麻|ごま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すって→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{和|あ}え{物|もの}→和え物：04979_aemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I ground sesame seeds in a mortar and made a dressed dish.

notes:
TYPES:
- {白|しろ}{胡麻|ごま}: white sesame
- {黒|くろ}{胡麻|ごま}: black sesame
- {金|きん}{胡麻|ごま}: golden sesame
- ⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧{胡麻|ごま}: ground sesame
- ⟦いり→いる：00495_iru⟧{胡麻|ごま}: roasted sesame

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胡麻|ごま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grind sesame (also: to flatter/suck up)
- {胡麻|ごま}{油|あぶら}: sesame oil
- {胡麻|ごま}だれ: sesame sauce/dressing
- {胡麻|ごま}{和|あ}え: sesame-dressed vegetables

IDIOM: {胡麻|ごま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ literally means "to grind sesame" but idiomatically means "to butter someone up" or "to flatter."
